answer: Only an ISO/IEC 27001 certificate issued by an accredited body like BSI stops a sybil tide: the audit takes 3 to 12 months, costs $10,000 to $40,000, and puts auditors on site checking 93 controls, from cipher key management to access logs. One agent identity maps to one certificate number, verified against the certification body's public register. A forger who fails the audit loses the fee and the horizon of fake agents collapses — forging 1,000 certified identities costs at least $10 million and a year of audits.
